keys.effect: NVIDIA DLSS Super Resolution mode: 1=Quality, 2=Balanced, 3=Performance, 4=Ultra Performance.
keys.notes: Only active when Anti-Aliasing is set to DeepLearningSuperSampling. Quality mode (1) yields optimal visual fidelity on 1440p+ displays.

keys.effect: NVIDIA DLSS 3 Frame Generation toggle: 'None' (Off) or 'On'.
keys.notes: Requires GeForce RTX 40-series GPU and Windows Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS) enabled. Significantly increases framerate on high-refresh panels.

keys.effect: XRender Global Illumination recipe preset index: 1=Low, 2=Medium, 3=High, 4=Custom/High.
keys.notes: Controls XRender indirect lighting quality and ray evaluation passes.
Adds depth and contact shadows around geometry and character models.
Enhances reflections on water bodies and glossy surface materials.

keys.effect: Bake Global Illumination reflection and irradiance probes: 0=Off, 1=On.
keys.notes: Improves interior and shaded ambient light realism.

keys.effect: Character and creature animation update rate and bone LOD: 1=Low, 2=Medium, 3=High.
keys.notes: High preserves full 60fps+ skeletal updates at distance without interpolation stutter.

keys.effect: Sun/directional main shadow map resolution and filtering: 0=Off, 1=Low, 2=Medium, 3=High.
keys.notes: High enables higher cascade resolution and soft shadow filtering.

keys.notes: Higher values eliminate creature pop-in in dense biomes. Recommended 50 on systems with 16GB+ RAM.

manual_only_settings.reason: Eliminates camera-induced disorientation and perceived motion blur during combat and exploration.
Reduces camera lag and velocity blur when pivoting around player character.
Aniimo compiles post-processing passes into its XRender graph. Lowering post-processing or cinematic blur mitigates artificial foreground/background blurring.

boot_config_keys.effect: Main thread native memory allocator block size (default 8388608 = 8MB).
boot_config_keys.notes: Increasing to 32MB (33554432) amortizes OS virtual memory allocation syscalls, preventing heap lock contention and traversal stutters.

boot_config_keys.effect: Worker thread memory allocator block size for C# Job System workers (default 8388608 = 8MB).
boot_config_keys.notes: Reduces allocation contention across worker threads.

boot_config_keys.effect: Main graphics command recording block size.
boot_config_keys.notes: Ensures allocation-free command list recording during dense scene rendering.

boot_config_keys.effect: Incremental garbage collection maximum time slice per frame in milliseconds (default 3ms).
boot_config_keys.notes: On 144Hz (6.94ms budget) or 240Hz (4.16ms budget) displays, a 3ms GC slice consumes up to 72% of the frame budget, causing dropped frames. Dropping to 1ms spreads collection work evenly across frames and eliminates frame spikes.
Set to 1 when playing on an HDR-capable monitor with Windows HDR active.

notes: Aniimo is developed on Unity 2022.3 with IL2CPP and a custom Scriptable Render Pipeline named XRender.

Motion Blur and Depth of Field do not have dedicated exposed registry keys in the current client build; they are handled inside XRender passes. Using DLSS Quality over TAA substantially sharpens motion clarity, and enabling DLSS 3 Frame Generation eliminates micro-stutter.

boot.config resides in %GAME_DIR%\Aniimo_Data\boot.config. Steam updates, game patches, and file integrity checks will overwrite this file with developer defaults, requiring re-application after updates.
Tuning memorysetup block sizes to 32MB (33554432) amortizes OS virtual memory allocation syscalls, drastically cutting traversal stutters in open-world areas.
Setting gc-max-time-slice=1 caps incremental garbage collection to 1ms per frame, preventing GC hitching on 144Hz-240Hz monitors.
